title: Hayati Pro Max Plus Double Menthol Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Double Menthol delivers a clean, icy flavour experience that stays sharp and consistent. Two layers of Menthol create a brisk, cooling vape with a smooth, frosty exhale that leaves a clean taste after every draw. Each Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod contains a 2ml pod and 10ml refill reservoir, offering 12ml of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid. There’s no need to refill or replace coils—just fit it to the Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod Kit and enjoy cool, refreshing vapour. With a dual mesh coil for consistent vapour production, each pod provides up to 6000 puffs (approx.), depending on usage. Replace with a new pod once vapour or flavour declines. Discover more flavours with our full selection of Hayati Pro Max Plus Pods .
